caption:
Student loan trouble is easing, at least in this one number. 🎓
The New York Fed says the share of student loan balances moving into serious delinquency (90+ days) fell to 7.72% in Q3 2026, down from 14.26% a year earlier.
Auto loans moved the other way slightly: 3.02% vs 2.99%.
If you have student loans, have you checked your servicer's reporting lately?
first_comment: Student loan borrowers: how's your repayment going this year? 👇

card.headline: Student loan serious delinquency nearly halved in a year.
